title: Round 1: draw the waiting calls

checklist.step: Recurse down to exponent 0 and return the right power
Show every call entering and leaving on the real stack

hints: A call for n cannot multiply until the call for n - 1 has returned. That waiting is what the stack shows.
Which exponent needs no recursive call, and what is any base raised to it?
Compute this call's result first, from the base case or from base times the recursive answer. Then draw the leave frame, then pop.
